title: User Activity Timeline
content: Build user activity timeline. Vertical timeline: chronological list of activities. Event types: different icons/colors per type. Time grouping: group by day or session. Details: expandable details per event. Filtering: filter by activity type. User context: show user info at top. Infinite scroll: load more as scrolling. Export: download activity log.

variants.simple: Show timeline of user activities and events.
variants.detailed: Build user activity timeline. Vertical timeline: chronological list of activities. Event types: different icons/colors per type. Time grouping: group by day or session. Details: expandable details per event. Filtering: filter by activity type. User context: show user info at top. Infinite scroll: load more as scrolling. Export: download activity log.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive user activity timeline for user analysis. Timeline layout: vertical chronological list, newest at top, date/time separators for grouping. Activity item: timestamp (relative or absolute), icon for activity type, activity description, additional context (IP, device, location). Activity types: logins/logouts, page views, clicks, form submissions, transactions, errors, support interactions, each with distinct icon and color. Expandable details: click to expand full activity details, request/response data (sanitized), related items. User header: user profile card at top, avatar, name, email, key user metrics (total activities, last active, lifetime value). Filtering: filter by activity type (checkboxes), date range picker, search within activities. Session grouping: group activities into sessions, collapsed session summary with expand. Infinite scroll: load 50 activities initially, load more on scroll, loading indicator. Empty state: "No activities in selected period". Export: download as CSV, full log or filtered view. Privacy: hide/mask sensitive data (passwords, tokens), access controls on who can view. Comparison: optionally compare to typical user behavior. Related users: link to related users (same IP, same company). Anomaly highlighting: flag unusual activities (suspicious login, error spike). Live mode: for support, show activities updating in real-time. Integration: link to related records (order details, support ticket). Time zone: display in user local time or viewer time with toggle.
